title: BioIVT: treatment names become a type-ahead RxNorm lookup
description: Turns the free-text treatment name on the Psoriasis form (oral steroid, topical, other) into a type-ahead lookup over a list of real RxNorm drug codes. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Option C: coded medication names at the point of entry (coded pick lists, OMOP-ready).
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
